headline: Ashoka Buildcon joint venture lowest bidder for ₹2,758 crore Jaipur Metro projects

summary: Ashoka Buildcon, in a joint venture with SAM India, has emerged as the lowest bidder for two Jaipur Metro Phase-II packages valued at ₹2,758.31 crore inclusive of GST. The scope of work includes constructing elevated viaducts and 23 stations. With this win, the company's total recent lowest bidder positions for metro and highway projects have crossed ₹4,200 crore. For an Indian retail investor, large public infrastructure wins signal steady execution pipelines and future revenue visibility for the company.
